norm_value_evidence.definition: Both versions define Ideal.absNorm toFun by Submodule.cardQuot, the natural cardinality of the quotient.
norm_value_evidence.formal_bridge: Ideal.absNorm_apply (I : Ideal S) : Ideal.absNorm I = I.cardQuot := rfl
norm_value_evidence.old_api_constraint: The old multiplicative Ideal.absNorm API requires Module.Free ℤ S. The value cardQuot does not require this hypothesis.
norm_value_evidence.new_api_constraint: The original source uses the later infinite-ring norm API. Requiring Module.Free on the port would narrow its generic source statements.

signature_justifications.finding: The temporary port added Module.Free ℤ R solely to elaborate old absNorm. This extra hypothesis has been removed.
signature_justifications.justification: The result uses exactly the same norm value under both source versions. Its proof uses finite_cardQuot_le and subtype preimage, requiring no multiplicativity or freeness.
signature_justifications.number_ring_bridge: A new public instance under the existing [Field K] [NumberField K] context changes cardQuot to old Ideal.absNorm definitionally. It is public so public cutoff and summatory definitions can synthesize it. It adds no hypothesis to those definitions or to the generic instance.
signature_justifications.public_type_effect: Generic norm spelling changes to an equal value; original generality is preserved. Original number-ring cutoff, summatory and counting signatures remain unchanged.

signature_justifications.finding: The temporary port added Module.Free ℤ R to the generic section. This extra hypothesis has been removed.
signature_justifications.final_generic_assumptions: {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] [Infinite R], with the original theorem-specific maximality, exponent, finite quotient, support and target-field assumptions.
signature_justifications.public_type_effect: Norm values in the three public formulas are written as cardQuot, definitionally the original absNorm values. No additional hypothesis or weakened conclusion is introduced.
signature_justifications.proof_justification: The product identity follows from the existing Chinese-remainder quotient equivalence and Nat.card_pi. Nonzero norm values follow from finite nonempty quotient cardinality. Divisor quotients are finite by the existing surjective quotient-factor map. This replaces old API constraints without changing the mathematics.

signature_justifications.finding: The temporary PerfectField replacement silently narrowed the original HasSeparableResidueFieldsAt hypothesis. The original hypothesis has been restored.
signature_justifications.public_type_effect: The original residue-separability predicate, theorem hypotheses and conclusion are retained.
signature_justifications.proof_justification: The exact later Mathlib predicate and generalized inertia-count proof are backported in Compat4331.SeparableResidueInertia using existing old normality, finite invariant extension, stabilizer/inertia quotient and ramification-count providers. No new axiom is added.
signature_justifications.implication: With integral extension assumptions, perfect residue fields imply HasSeparableResidueFieldsAt. The converse fails: an identity extension of an imperfect characteristic-p rational function field is separable but its base field is not perfect.
signature_justifications.main_proof_impact: Known number-field integer-ring callers had perfect residue fields, so the temporary narrowing was compatible with those callers; that does not justify narrowing the published generic theorem.
